brief:
Bitcoin Magazine published commentary by Sam Callahan contending that bitcoin's success does not depend on interest rate reductions by the Federal Reserve. Callahan examined broader economic trends including a 20% loss in U.S. dollar purchasing power over five years, elevated core personal consumption expenditures inflation readings, and significant drawdowns in the U.S. bond market.

The analysis framed these conditions within the concept of financial repression, suggesting structural economic pressures rather than monetary policy shifts may support bitcoin adoption and value.

title: Bitcoin Magazine argues bitcoin thrives without Federal Reserve rate cuts
